title: circaea alpina subsp. micrantha
intro: Circaea alpina subsp. micrantha, commonly known as Alpine Enchanter's Nightshade or Small-flowered Enchanter's Nightshade, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Lythraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
